title: CalCOFI measurements catalog record (measurements.json)
description: One record per release: every measurement key the release's obs_env carries (the registry's `variable` where set, else the measurement_type), its series one per measurement_type x dataset, their counts by year, month, depth band and quality code, the declared bounds and observed quantiles, and the other keys sharing a NERC P01 concept that are kept apart on purpose. 1.1 adds, per key, the five face registries CalCOFI authors (face, chem, method, scale, why) and the per-depth-band `anomaly` measured against the release's own climatology; every 1.1 field is OPTIONAL, so a 1.0 record validates unchanged and a 1.0 consumer reads a 1.1 record. Written by calcofi4db::build_measurements_catalog() beside taxa.json; read by calcofi.io/measurements/.

measurements.description: measurement keys with a series in obs_env

series.description: measurement_type x dataset pairs in obs_env

obs_env_rows.description: rows of obs_env; equals the sum of series[].n_values over every key

full_rows.description: every environmental measurement the release publishes: obs_env_rows plus the full-resolution supplementals (obs_ctd_full, obs_mets_full); null when a supplemental is neither on the connection nor supplied

pages.description: length of measurements[]: one page per key

full_resolution_only.description: registry rows this dataset declares that never reach obs_env — a raw sensor, a thermosalinograph past the first. No page; they live in the full-resolution supplemental named by `table`.

flags.description: the series[].flags vocabulary this record was written with — calcofi4db::measurement_series_flags()

series_flag.description: sensor_mean: the registry's derivation says it is a mean of a sensor pair · replicate: a _rep series beside a mean · reported_pre_qc: an r_ series reported before QC · no_bound: neither valid_min nor valid_max is declared · sentinel_suspected: the observed max exceeds the declared valid_max, or reaches 99 with no bound declared · no_flag_at_grain: the registry names no quality column, so the series reaches the release with no flag · no_p01: no NERC P01 concept says exactly this

key.description: the registry's `variable` where set, else the measurement_type

slug.description: the page directory /measurements/{slug}/ — equal to key, which is already URL-safe

label.description: from metadata/variable.csv; absent a row, the canonical series' registry description, and the measurement carries the no_label flag

nerc_p01.description: null means no concept says exactly this, never 'not looked at'

is_unified.description: more than one measurement_type resolves to this key

climatology.description: the release's climatology table carries one of this key's types

declared_by.description: the measurement_types that declare a bound

qual_ok_n.description: 1.1 — values the release's own qual_ok keeps, over every series of the key

n_flagged.description: 1.1 — n_values less qual_ok_n: what a provider's quality flag removed from observed{} and from every derived number on the page

series.description: one per measurement_type x dataset in obs_env, most values first

related.description: other keys sharing this key's NERC P01 concept, kept apart on purpose, with the reason. A pair the vocabulary states no reason for is not listed.

why.description: underway_vs_cast: one side is an underway intake · same_bottles: one side is another dataset's own copy of the bottle table, plausibly the same physical bottles · replicate_vs_mean: a _rep replicate beside a mean · pre_qc_twin: an r_ series reported before QC · sensor_vs_mean: a raw sensor beside the mean of its pair, in the same dataset · paired_sensors: the two sensors of one instrument, neither of them the mean · same_casts: two datasets sampling the same water on the same casts, with no sharper marker

flags.description: no_label: no metadata/variable.csv row supplies a display label, so `label` is the canonical series' registry description

face.description: 1.1 — metadata/measurement_face.csv: what the page draws for this key. `structure` a molecule, `composition` a pool or mixture given as rows, `scale` a physical scale, `organism` a taxon, `standsin` a borrowed face named by face_of (never shown as this key's own identity), `none` no face.

face_of.description: the key whose face stands in for this one

chem.description: 1.1 — metadata/measurement_chem.csv: one ChEBI entity of this measurement, and how it belongs to it. `via` says whether the identity came from the P01's own S27 (nerc_s27) or from the registry (registry). ChEBI ROLES are never carried: dioxygen's include 'anti-inflammatory drug'.

method.description: 1.1 — metadata/measurement_method.csv, one entry per SERIES of this key that the registry carries a row for: how that dataset takes this measurement, authored from the provider's own method page and cited.

nerc_l22.description: the NERC L22 device concept, filled only on an exact match

scale.description: 1.1 — metadata/measurement_scale.csv: one mark on the familiar scale. A `computed` mark is a function of stated inputs and is RECOMPUTED at build from its own `how`; computed_at_build says whether this build could (carbonate-chemistry marks have no R equivalent installed and pass through the registry's value).

why.description: 1.1 — metadata/measurement_why.csv: why this measurement matters, ranked. Rank 1 is the page's pick and must carry a citation; the rest are one click away. A `goos` entry quotes one question from the EOV specification sheet and links it, never a paragraph.

anomaly.description: 1.1 — the yearly departure from the release's own climatology, per depth band of depth_bands' edges, for a key the climatology covers. obs_env joins climatology on dataset_key, measurement_type, site_key, calendar month and 10 m depth bin; qual_ok only (a provider's flag outranks a bound in anything derived); the mean is taken per cruise and then over cruises. A unified key merges its series' rows before aggregating, each series against the normal of its own measurement_type.

baseline.description: the climatology window stamped on every climatology row

ymax.description: the symmetric y limit shared by every band of this key, set by the years meeting min_cruises; a thinner year beyond it is clipped by the page

spark_band.description: the band with the most values: what the head's sparkline draws

min_cruises.description: the cruises a year needs before it may set the trend, the extremes or ymax

n_values.description: values in this band that found a climatology row

series.description: [year, anom, n_cruises, n_values] per year, oldest first

trend.description: least squares over the years inside the trend window that meet min_cruises; null when fewer than two such years

ext.description: the highest and lowest year of the band, over the years meeting min_cruises: [year, anom]

deeper.description: bands this key is measured in that no climatology row reaches, so the page can say a deep band has no normal rather than draw nothing

source_column.description: what the source called the column

qual_column.description: null means the series carries no quality code at the release grain

years.description: values per year; rows with no year are absent, so the sum is at most n_values

depth_bands.description: counts by band of depth_min_m, left-closed and right-open

qual.description: values per measurement_qual code, each dataset's own uninterpreted vocabulary; 'none' is the rows carrying no code

qual_ok_n.description: values the release's own qual_ok keeps

n_flagged.description: 1.1 — n_values less qual_ok_n: the values a provider's quality flag removed from observed{}. The landing page's heads-up reads this rather than recomputing it.

out_of_bounds.description: the finite values outside the series' declared valid_min / valid_max, which observed{} excludes. null when the registry declares no bound; n is 0 with null min/max when nothing falls outside. n is NOT subtracted from n_values: the raw counts are what the release's arithmetic gate checks.

observed.description: quantiles of the finite values that are WITHIN the declared bounds AND pass the release's qual_ok; NaN, infinities, out-of-bounds values and values a provider flagged are excluded (1.1: a provider's quality flag outranks a physical bound, so a flagged extreme inside the bounds is not in this range either — it is counted in n_flagged)
